title: Reconcile orphaned dashboard values and tracing gaps after metrics-shard failover
creator: Aisha Moreno
description:
Summary: During a regional metrics ingestion failover on 2026-02-17 customers reported dashboards showing 'null' or stale values and distributed trace links missing / failing to stitch. This ticket scopes the end-to-end fix: reconcile metric shards, repair dashboard materialized views, and restore trace->metric stitching so runbooks and live panels show consistent data.

Impact: Multiple Hosted and Dedicated tenants experienced broken console widgets and delayed alerting. Several customers opened support escalations citing missing SLAs for monitoring.

Observed behavior / reproduction steps:
1) Triggered shard failover during scheduled capacity rebalancing in us-west-2.
2) Some metric shards were re-ingested without preserving original ingestion watermark; dashboards with TTL-based queries returned empty result sets for time windows overlapping the failover.
3) Trace IDs emitted during the window have partial spans in trace storage and were not linked to the metric stream due to a downstream index mismatch (shard id drift).

Root cause hypothesis: The ingestion coordinator retried shard moves without atomically advancing the tenant watermark. This allowed metric writes to be accepted into a new shard with older segment timestamps. The dashboard materialized queries use a TTL + watermark join to the metric index; mismatch led to rows being treated as expired. Tracing linker uses a composite key (tenant + shard + seq) — shard id drift broke lookups.

Mitigation applied (hotfixes already live):
- Temporarily blocked further automated shard moves (coordination flag set) — rollback at 2026-02-17 23:45 UTC.
- Introduced a repair job to re-index ingestion events for affected shards into a holding index for reconciliation. Job ran on 2026-02-18 and produced candidate rows.
- Enabled a conservative query fallback in the console that ignores TTL for 1 hour for widgets flagged as possibly affected (reduces false nulls while we reconcile).

Proposed permanent fix (this ticket):
1) Add atomic watermark advance to shard move protocol (runtime + coordinator) so new shard accepts writes with correct sequence offset.
2) Run a one-time reconciliation pipeline that: replays affected ingestion segments -> rewrites segment timestamps -> re-applies TTL pruning in a controlled window -> populates materialized widget caches.
3) Repair the trace->metric indexer to tolerate shard id drift for 72 hours by using alternate lookup paths (span hashes and ingestion event IDs) while backfilling canonical keys.
4) Add end-to-end integration tests that simulate partial shard moves and verify dashboard widget continuity and trace stitching.

Rollout plan:
- Week 0: Merge coordinator change behind feature flag (canary in staging).
- Week 1: Deploy repair pipeline and run on one low-impact customer tenant; validate dashboards and trace links.
- Week 2: Gradual rollout to remaining affected tenants with monitoring alerts.
- Post-rollout: Remove console TTL fallback, mark incident resolved in runbook.

Observability and validation metrics we will track:
- % of previously-null dashboard widgets returning valid data (goal: >= 98% within 48h of reconciliation)
- Trace->metric link success rate for affected windows (goal: >= 99%)
- Repair job error rate and throughput
- Coordinator shard-move success latency

Artifacts and links:
- Incident runbook: https://confluence.redwood.ai/incident/2026-02-metrics-shard-failover
- Staging repro script: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ops-scripts/tree/main/staging/shard-replay
- Repair pipeline PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ingest/pull/4581
- Coordinator atomic watermark RFC: https://docs.redwood.ai/rfcs/rfc-coord-watermark-2026.md

Acceptance criteria:
- Coordinator performs shard moves without watermark regressions in integration tests.
- Repair pipeline backfills and reduces null widgets to <2% within validated tenants.
- Trace indexing backfill restores trace->metric linking for the incident window with no data duplication.
- Observability dashboards show steady-state and alerts are cleared for reconciled tenants.

Postmortem actions to add after resolve:
- Update autoscaling docs to require a pre-move watermark snapshot (owner: infra).
- Add runbook step to detect shard id drift within 5 minutes (owner: oncall).
- Customer comms template for similar escalations (owner: customer-success).
